description: Zubauzahlen von Photovoltaik-Anlagen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesministerium des Innern und Heimat. Die Tabelle zeigt die Summe der installierten Leistung von Photovoltaik-Anlagen in der Einheit "Megawatt Peak" (MWp). Coverage: Germany. The portal files it under the publisher Bundesministerium des Innern und Heimat. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2022-03-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 (ältere DCAT-AP.de Version). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
